Lantern Hollow 1.0
==================

Lantern Hollow is a small free game about keeping the lights on in a quiet valley.
It is a fictional game made for testing the Vortex launcher.

Installing
----------
Keep all files of this download in one folder:

  setup_lantern_hollow.exe
  setup_lantern_hollow-1.bin
  setup_lantern_hollow-2.bin
  redist\prereq_setup.exe
  manual\

Run setup_lantern_hollow.exe and follow the wizard. Setup installs the Lantern Hollow Runtime
from the redist folder for you.

The manual (manual\index.html) is also copied into the game folder.

Saved games are kept in %APPDATA%\LanternHollow and are not removed by the uninstaller.
